sections.title: Supplier
sections.sql: select code,name from spend.suppliers where id=$1

sections.title: Purchasing history
sections.sql: select entity,invoice,invoice_on,currency,amount,category,po from spend.enriched where supplier_id=$1 order by invoice_on

sections.title: Recorded name mappings
sections.sql: select source_system,alias,reason from spend.aliases where supplier_id=$1

sections.title: Records
sections.sql: select invoice,invoice_on,currency,amount,evidence_ref,retain_until from spend.enriched where entity_id=$1 order by invoice_on

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select g.invoice,g.rule,g.finding from spend.evidence_gaps g join spend.lines l on l.id=g.id where l.entity_id=$1 order by g.invoice
